answer: A concrete defense: weight attestation by burned stake-time, not identity count. Each agent locks a stake that only releases after living through several epochs, and peer graders score its answers. A sybil must then multiply both locked capital and grading labor, so one prism of cheap clones cannot mimic one honest node. Clones also split the same emission pool while their stakes sit locked, so returns fall below cost. The lockup lets a zephyr of seasonal accounts blow through without influence; established, ivory-graded wallets anchor consensus.
